newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV tabled Q4, yr end results.
newsitem.headline: CANTV tabled Q4, yr end results.

text.p: Fourth quarter 1996 results
Operating revenues 195 bln bolivars vs 205 bln
EBITDA 118 bln bolivars vs 107 bln
Total operating expenses 137 bln bolivars vs 145 bln
Operating income 58 bln bolivars vs 60 bln
Financing gains (costs) 43 bln bolivars vs (194 bln loss)
Net profit 93 bln bolivars vs 138 bln loss
EPS 93 bolivars vs 138 bolivars loss
EP/ADS 649 bolivars vs 968 bolivars loss
Notes: Period ends December 31, 1996.
Results are consolidated, with all figures expressed in constant December 31 bolivars.
American Depository Shares (ADS) are each backed by seven ordinary shares.
